subject.title: fix: discord exec approvals fails against local self-signed TLS gateway

question: Should maintainers repair and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204 as the shared bootstrap TLS fingerprint fix, or replace it with a clean equivalent?
rationale: The remaining work changes certificate fingerprint trust routing for Gateway clients, and the active PR is already the candidate but still needs security-boundary review and reconciliation before merge.

options.title: Repair and review active PR
options.body: Resolve the active PR's remaining branch/import drift, then validate local, remote, env, CLI, and non-WSS TLS fingerprint semantics before merge.

options.title: Replace with clean successor
options.body: Open a narrow replacement if the active branch remains hard to reconcile, preserving the contributor's shared-bootstrap fix intent.

options.title: Hold for TLS policy review
options.body: Keep the issue open without landing until maintainers revisit local, remote, CLI, and env TLS pin precedence as a broader policy decision.

recommendation.title: Repair and review active PR
recommendation.body: Resolve the active PR's remaining branch/import drift, then validate local, remote, env, CLI, and non-WSS TLS fingerprint semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Gateway client, approval helper, and TLS/auth history makes them the strongest routing owner for the trust-boundary choice.
